description: This file defines an abstract base class for integration tests related to device registry functionalities within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes helper methods for error assertion and connection management during testing.

classes.name: DeviceRegistryTestBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common setup and utility methods for device registry integration tests.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the test helper.

methods.name: assertErrorCode
methods.description: Asserts that a given Throwable is a ServiceInvocationException with a specific error code.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection factory and flags test checkpoint upon successful disconnection.
